verdict.rationale: Bugbot's review rules can live in repository `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files, so they could be versioned, reviewed, and reverted through ordinary git and PR workflows. Admins can also define org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and verbose mode shows which rules loaded in a given review. None of this is a documented versioning or rollback feature for automations; it is implied by the files living in git. missing for 10: explicit version history for org-wide Bugbot Automations, a documented rollback/restore mechanism, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, independent corroboration.
